title: Graphs without a 4-cycle: every circuit of AND and OR gates for the edge function has at least |E| + tau - 1 gates
formal_statement: ∀ (n t : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit), (∃ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v) → (∀ a b c d : Fin n, a ≠ b → a ≠ c → a ≠ d → b ≠ c → b ≠ d → c ≠ d → G.Adj a b → G.Adj b c → G.Adj c d → ¬ G.Adj d a) → (∃ S : Finset (Fin n), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.CoverPromise.IsVertexCover G S ∧ S.card = t) → (∀ S : Finset (Fin n), PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.CoverPromise.IsVertexCover G S → t ≤ S.card) → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C → (∀ x : Fin n → Bool, (C.eval (List.ofFn x) = true ↔ ∃ u v : Fin n, G.Adj u v ∧ x u = true ∧ x v = true)) → G.edgeSet.ncard + t ≤ C.size + 1
plain_statement: Let G be a graph on n vertices with at least one edge and no 4-cycle (no four distinct vertices a, b, c, d with ab, bc, cd, da all edges); triangles and every degree are allowed. Let t be its vertex cover number. Every circuit of AND and OR gates only, each reading at most two wires, every gate counted, that computes the edge function of G (true exactly when both ends of some edge are true) has at least |E| + t - 1 gates.
